purpose: Exact byte transport of original independent evidence archive; no member reconstruction or repackaging. GitHub connector refuses request bodies above16MiB, so14.6MiB archive cannot be uploaded as one base64 blob. Ordered concatenation recovers original archive exactly.
reassemble_python: from pathlib import Path; p=Path('.'); (p/'closure-independent-source-reviews-evidence.tar.gz').write_bytes(b''.join((p/n).read_bytes() for n in ['closure-independent-source-reviews-evidence.tar.gz.part-001', 'closure-independent-source-reviews-evidence.tar.gz.part-002']))
